interventions.amplitude_rationale: Fixed round scale probes: +5 degC mean GPU temperature; +120 W GPU total and +150 W PSU AC. Not sensor limits, not fault models, no amplitude search.

analysis.control_matching: same group, equal ticks, all complete, no candidate within control or 60s guard; prefer same start-hour, then nearest start, then earlier; reuse allowed and reported
metrics: IF supported tick fractions/host counts/R witness intersection/signed nearest delay
simultaneous active groups and run lengths
synthetic incremental vs existing baseline positives and onset delay
analysis.inference: descriptive distribution over 20 controls; no independent-tick significance test, no fault quality metrics

acceptance.invalid_covariance: B unknown, retain reason; never drop bad seeds
acceptance.missing: R/B unknown and causal event break
